notes.subject: נטל עליו
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV: 'he hath borne/laid it upon him' (jɔyɔrɔ laseli); YLT/JPS: min b'a fa — mɔgɔ yɛrɛ walima Yawe; ni Yawe de y'a fa, o bɛ Kɔfɛ-ni cogo jira.

notes.subject: נטל עליו
notes.rationale: Sɛgɛsɛgɛli filanan: Yawe min b'a fa a kan — 'sabu ⟨Yawe⟩ b'a fa a kan' dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka kɛ.

notes.subject: וידם
notes.rationale: a k'ɔ dia — דומם ka kɔrɔ ye kuma jiligɛ ye, a tɛ 'siraya' ye.

translation: A k'a jɔ ko ɲɔgɔn yɛrɛ, a k'ɔ dia, sabu o baara faa bɛ a kan.
